title: checkin_opened payload, pv 1 (PROPOSED, docs/VUKA-2-SPEC.md §4b)
description: Committed private payload of a checkin_opened event: the check-in was confirmed shown on screen (V4). Numeric fields are integers (spec §5). Adding a field is a pv bump.

checkin_id.description: Device-generated lowercase UUID; also the {id} in /v1/checkins/{id}/opened and /result. Device-generated so a check-in can be queued offline (V8).

journey_id.description: The journey this check-in belongs to, as in signal_detected.

signal_event_id.description: details.event_id of the signal_detected event that triggered this check-in. The server uses it to cancel that signal's no_answer_fallback (§8, G34).

window_s.description: Device-chosen check-in window in seconds; §7 limits it to 20 or 60. Named window_s, not window_ms, so it is not confused with signal_detected's 975 ms audio window.
